twice: I have read that book twice.
whereas: He prefers tea, whereas I prefer coffee.
他喜欢茶，而我更喜欢咖啡。
moreover: The plan is cheap; moreover, it is quick.
这个方案成本低；而且，它还很快。
nevertheless: The task was hard; nevertheless, they finished it.
任务很艰巨；尽管如此，他们还是完成了。
anywhere: I cannot find my keys anywhere.
besides: Besides, we have no money for it.
再说，我们也没钱做这件事。
everywhere: There was dust everywhere in the room.
meanwhile: He cooked; meanwhile, I set the table.
他做饭，与此同时我摆好了餐具。
furthermore: It is cheap; furthermore, it lasts longer.
elsewhere: The shop was closed, so we ate elsewhere.
那家店关门了，我们只好去别处吃。
abroad: She has lived abroad for ten years.
secondly: Secondly, it costs far too much.
hence: The road was closed; hence the delay.
道路封闭，因此造成了延误。
anymore: I do not live there anymore.
whenever: Call me whenever you need help.
你什么时候需要帮助，就给我打电话。
consequently: It rained all week; consequently, the match was cancelled.
雨下了一整周，因此比赛取消了。
whilst: She read whilst waiting for the train.
firstly: 首先，我们需要更多数据。
altogether: There are altogether twenty students in the class.
这个班总共有二十名学生。
alongside: He worked alongside his father for years.
他和他父亲一起工作了很多年。
